page: Amazon Web Services c8id.32xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor. It features 128 vCPUs and 64 physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor running at 3.9 GHz. The system is equipped with 256 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 7 GHz, providing 2.0 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, the instance includes 7600 GB of NVMe SSD capacity, and it delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 50 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier multi-core performance, with stress-ng multi-core and Geekbench multi-core scores placing in the top 10% of tested systems. The processor's advanced instruction support, including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), drives strong results in cryptography, physics simulations, and ray tracing. Memory performance is highly competitive, with read-only memory bandwidth reaching top-tier levels for both cached and uncached blocks. Single-core performance is moderate, aligning with the average tier in stress-ng single-core tests.

This instance is designed for compute-intensive workloads that require high-speed local storage and substantial memory bandwidth. It is highly effective for database operations, software compilation, and medium-to-large LLM prompt processing. The integration of 7600 GB of NVMe SSD storage alongside 128 dedicated vCPUs offers a cost-efficient profile for data-dense applications, eliminating the need for external storage attachments while maintaining high throughput.
